title: ItemViz
description: A client-side mod that gives you complete control to easily resize and reposition items and blocks in your hand and inventory using an in-game UI.
body:
ItemViz
ItemViz is a powerful client-side Fabric utility mod that gives you complete, granular control over how items and blocks look both when held in your hand (first-person view) and when rendered inside your inventory UI.

Whether you're a PvP player looking to shrink massive weapons to clear up screen space, or a builder who wants to tweak exactly how blocks sit in your hand, ItemViz provides a seamless in-game interface to make it happen.

Features
Total Visual Control: Adjust the Size, X, and Y offsets of any individual item or block independently.
In-Game Configuration Menu: No need to edit config files manually! Simply press the dedicated keybind or type /itemviz in chat to open a sleek, interactive configuration menu.
Hand & Inventory Scaling: Settings are split into two categories. You can shrink a sword in your hand while keeping it normal-sized in your inventory, or vice-versa.
Custom Backgrounds: Add custom colored backgrounds behind items in the configuration previews to help you see how they look against different colors.
Multiple UI Themes: Customize the look of the ItemViz configuration menu itself with built-in Classic, Light, and Dark themes.
Neat & Shareable Configs: All custom settings are saved securely in config/itemviz/items.json. Unmodified items are automatically kept out of the file to keep it clean, making it extremely easy to share your perfect PvP setups with friends or include them in modpacks.
How to Use
Launch the game and join a world or server.
Press the ItemViz Menu Key (configurable in standard Minecraft Controls) or type /itemviz in chat.
Select any item from the scrolling list on the left.
Use the sliders on the right to tweak the Size, Position X, and Position Y for both the "In Hand" view and the "Inventory" view.
Watch the live previews update instantly!
Click "Done" to save. Any item you reset to its default size will automatically be cleaned from your config file.
Installation
ItemViz is a client-side only mod. You only need to install it on your client; it will work on any multiplayer server!

Requires Fabric Loader.
Requires Fabric API.
